expectedRealization.rationale: WFH notebook demand and supply disruption can resolve over one to two quarters, but the cutoff signal is contradictory.

changeHypothesis.summary: Remote-work notebook demand appeared, yet supply was disrupted and the full-year notebook forecast was still reduced. A headline beneficiary trade would ignore the demand/supply conflict.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: WFH can persist, but global consumer weakness and supply constraints may offset it.
disconfirmingEvidence: TrendForce still cut the full-year notebook forecast despite late-March WFH demand.

falseThemeMatches: all PC/component stocks assumed to benefit from WFH

selectionComparison.rationale: No selection because the physical demand and supply evidence conflicts and no company-specific pricing power is frozen.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: WFH was already a visible narrative by late March.
expectations.thesisExpectation: Only a verified component bottleneck or company-specific earnings bridge should convert the theme into a selection.

bearCase: WFH headlines lift concepts while actual shipments and full-year demand disappoint.

nextResearchActions: No selection; keep as a conflict/fail-closed case.
